description: Smoke automation norms, env shape, teach track, and pointers. Grid rows live in smoke-manifest.json.

project.name: corner-delivery-smoke
project.purpose: Delivery smoke automation: one statistical pass/fail per behavior with execution evidence. Not epic TEST-PREP manual drafts.

principles.narrow_oracle: Exactly one narrow_oracle per manifest row; no unrelated assertions in a single test.
principles.no_hardcoding: No URLs, usernames, or passwords in tests/; resolve via env_profile and gitignored credentials overlay.
principles.evidence_required: Pass is invalid if required evidence artifacts are missing for that row.
principles.grid_first: No new test module without a matching manifest.rows[].id.
principles.sandbox: Experiments only under auto-tests/tmp/ or other gitignored paths — not under tests/.

profiles.label: CT QA
profiles.note: Hosts only — confirm roles and credentials in /teach before flipping confirmation_status to confirmed.

credentials_overlay.note: Maps logical roles to secrets; see auto-tests/docs/. Never commit.

verdict_types.ui_state: Playwright — one UI state or visible condition after a bounded flow.
verdict_types.http_status: Reserved for phase 2 API suite — fixed endpoint returns expected status.
verdict_types.metric_match: One metric or value matches console or declared oracle within tolerance.
verdict_types.absence: Specific error, banner, or element must not appear.
verdict_types.job_allowed: WebBroker job monitor — allowed jobs present or executable.
verdict_types.component_health: dxCore component check — no exceptions / health signal.

phases.name: spec
phases.goal: Define automation_scope and narrow_oracle for one manifest row.
phases.exit_criteria: Row has non-null automation_scope and narrow_oracle.statement.

phases.name: fixtures
phases.goal: Env profile and session fixtures; wiring test only.
phases.exit_criteria: pytest can load env_profile without product oracle.

phases.name: oracle
phases.goal: Single test module implementing one row verdict.
phases.exit_criteria: One test tied to manifest id; single assert path.

phases.name: evidence
phases.goal: Evidence hooks and report row shape.

api_suite.note: Fixed endpoint list; separate api-manifest.json. Not smoke v1.

adaptive.note: Adaptive shell not in smoke v1; execution description mentions adaptive for manual scope only.

dxsca.note: Execution lists dxSCA component; no dxSCA automation in v1.

smoke_execution_context.narrative: CRTQA-10247 is the Corner delivery smoke template execution. It bundles 32 CRTQA Test issues across dxTrade5, WebBroker, dxWeb (one API case), and dxCore health checks. Manual execution uses a Smart Checklist on the execution (Zabbix, login across surfaces, header metrics, widgets, order lifecycle, positions, charts, watchlists, WB administration, API transaction).
smoke_execution_context.automation_stance: Each CRTQA manual test may describe many steps. Each smoke-manifest row automates one narrow proof only — fill automation_scope and narrow_oracle in /teach phase 0 before implementation.
